episodes.title: 20 ans
episodes.summary: As Marseille's mayor rallies support for a controversial casino project, his longtime protégé prepares to take a bold step.

episodes.title: Homme de paille
episodes.summary: While Barrès and Taro plot their next moves, a brutal act jolts the city. Rachel tries to find out what her husband is hiding.

episodes.title: Crocodile
episodes.summary: Mysterious messages put Taro on edge as he seeks a shortcut back into the race. Rachel struggles to come to terms with her new future.

episodes.title: Intox
episodes.summary: With the party in turmoil, Barrès grows bolder in his attacks. Taro makes a startling discovery about his rival's past.

episodes.title: Face à Face
episodes.summary: Julia confronts Lucas as her father begins to have second thoughts about the campaign. A jealous Eric tries to sabotage Sélim.

episodes.title: Liberté, Egalité, sans Pitié
episodes.summary: An anonymous email stokes tensions between Robert and Rachel. Julia comes up with a shrewd campaign ploy, while Farid tries to rig the vote.

episodes.title: A voté
episodes.summary: Shifting allegiances and devastating twists leave the campaigns reeling as the final vote looms.

episodes.title: La Lutte Finale
episodes.summary: A bombshell in the debate shakes up the race. Meanwhile, Julia visits the prison and begins to piece together a long-buried story.

episodes.title: Perjury
episodes.summary: With the election thrown into turmoil, Lucas finds himself at the center of a political feeding frenzy. Rachel makes a dramatic public statement.

episodes.title: Dominance
episodes.summary: As Lucas adjusts to his new role, the death of a public figure rattles the city. Julia digs for information on a mystery man who's suddenly vanished.

episodes.title: Conquest
episodes.summary: While Robert fights the stadium sale, Jeanne pressures Lucas to beef up the city's security. Julia's suspicions lead her into dangerous territory.

episodes.title: Resistance
episodes.summary: Robert forges ahead with Julia's research, Jeanne goes rogue, and Rachel takes a risk to help Tod. Meanwhile, Chahid prepares for his mission.

episodes.title: Capitulation
episodes.summary: As Eric tries to avert a tragedy, Driss makes an unexpected announcement. A crisis leaves Lucas stuck in a difficult -- and vulnerable -- position.

episodes.title: Revelation
episodes.summary: Sweeping changes at City Hall inflame tensions across Marseille. Eric tips Rachel off to Julia's ordeal. Jeanne makes an unsettling discovery.

episodes.title: Abandon
episodes.summary: As the city again mourns one of its own, Robert vows to track down the culprits. Lucas grapples with Jeanne's news. Eric begins to unravel.

episodes.title: Justice
episodes.summary: Julia tries a new tactic to recover her memories, Jeanne takes a drastic step to protect her career, and Robert and Lucas plot to save their city.
